questions.question:
[지문]
Different colored foods help our bodies in different ways. ⓐWhat do each color of food do for our bodies? Red foods such as cherries and tomatoes promote heart health and blood circulation. ⓑThey also help to strengthen your immune system. ⓒOrange foods know to be good for skin and eye health because they are rich in vitamin A. ⓓSo add carrots and sweet potatoes to your shopping list. ⓔYellow foods keep our brains and stomachs health. So try some delicious yellow foods like pineapple, corn, and golden kiwifruit.

ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳은 것들을 모두 골라 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation:
ⓐ 'What do each color of food do' → each는 단수 취급이므로 'What does each color of food do'가 되어야 합니다. 오류.
ⓑ 'They also help to strengthen your immune system.' → 어법상 옳습니다.
ⓒ 'Orange foods know to be good' → 수동태가 되어야 하므로 'are known to be good'이 되어야 합니다. 오류.
ⓓ 'So add carrots and sweet potatoes to your shopping list.' → 명령문으로 어법상 옳습니다.
ⓔ 'Yellow foods keep our brains and stomachs health' → health는 명사이므로 형용사 healthy가 되어야 합니다. 오류.
따라서 옳은 것은 ⓑ, ⓓ입니다.

Now, let's (b)move on to ginger. What body part comes to (c)mind when you see it? Doesn't it look like a (d)stomach? You may (e)like ginger's strong taste or smell, but these come from a special chemical that prevents you from feeling sick and throwing up. For this reason, ginger can be good for your stomach.

글의 전체 흐름으로 볼 때 (a)~(e) 중 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 생강의 강한 맛이나 냄새를 좋아하지 않을 수도 있다(dislike/not like)는 내용이 되어야 자연스럽습니다. 뒤에 'but these come from a special chemical'이라며 역접이 나오므로, (e) 'like'는 'dislike' 또는 'not like'가 되어야 합니다.

일곱 번째 단어는 'from'입니다.

questions.question:
영영풀이가 옳게 제시된 단어끼리 짝지어진 것은?

<보기>
ⓐ hollow: able to be used easily
ⓑ cell: the smallest functional unit of a living thing
ⓒ clue: information that helps you understand something
ⓓ beneficial: something that has been done in the wrong way
ⓔ prevent: used to say that something belongs or relates to a particular person or thing
questions.explanation: ⓐ hollow는 '빈'의 의미이므로 영영풀이가 틀렸고, ⓓ beneficial은 '이로운'의 의미이므로 영영풀이가 틀렸으며, ⓔ prevent는 '막다, 예방하다'의 의미이므로 영영풀이가 틀렸다. ⓑ cell(세포: 살아있는 것의 가장 작은 기능적 단위)과 ⓒ clue(단서: 무언가를 이해하는 데 도움을 주는 정보)의 영영풀이는 옳다.

options: 온라인 운동 영상은 요즘 인기가 있다.

다음 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 고르시오.

Jane: What are you doing in the living room?
Pete: I'm doing yoga.
Jane: You're working out by yourself?
Pete: Yes, I'm following this online video. It shows me all the steps.
Jane: Let me see. Wow, it's been watched 2 million times! I'm surprised that so many people have watched this video.
Pete: I know! These kinds of programs are becoming popular right now.
Jane: It looks very convenient. You don't have to go out to exercise.
Pete: That's right. That's why I love these programs. You should try them, too.
